newsitem.title: FINLAND: Dollar rally still helping Helsinki to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rally still helping Helsinki to new highs.

text.p: Shares again hit new records on Tuesday as forestries continued a bull-run on the back of a fast-firming dollar -- which also helped bellwhether Nokia, brokers said.
The HEX general index ended 1.29 percent higher at 2462.22 points, a new record close and just a touch off its new life-high 2462.72 set during Tuesday's trading.

The forestry sub-index rose 1.2 percent but analysts saw little fundamental grounds for the boom. "We think this is not yet the turnaround of a permanent trend (though) it could last for a month or two supported by the strong dollar," said one.
"The strong dollar bodes well for forestry shares. The market can go higher this week, though we might have some recoil days if this pace continues," one broker said.

Mobile phone maker Benefon became the session's loser after it warned of lower second half operating profits and again gave no estimate of when it would launch its digital handset. It lost about 10 percent to close at 82.00 markka, down 9.50.

Long-term bond yields hit all-time lows, boosting demand for banking shares. Merita set yet another all-time high at 15.20 markka and closed at 15.00, still up 0.30. OKOBANK advanced one markka to 66.00.
